edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

  • Classes in edu.uky.cs.nil.sg used by edu.uky.cs.nil.sg
    Class
    Description
    BigHashMap
    A map based on a hash table, which uses a hash function to map keys to an array of values.
    BigMap
    A custom implementation of a map, which associates unique keys with values, which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY entries, and which uses long integers to measure its BigMap.size().
    BigSet
    A custom implementation of a collection that does not allow duplicates which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to measure its BigSet.size().
    BreadthFirstSearch
    A task that performs a breadth-first search of a story graph, starting at node 0, and labeling each node based on the order in which it was visited by the search.
    Entry
    An individual key/value pair in a map.
    ExplanationTree
    An object for building explanations by prepending temporal edges to the start of the sequence.
    GraphSnapshot
    An object for printing summary statistics about a story graph before and after it has been modified.
    Option
    An option that can be used to configure a story graph tool when passed as an argument.
    PlanTree
    An object for building plans by prepending actions to the start of the sequence so that when duplicate plans are created the same object is reused to save memory.
    PlanTree.Root
    The empty plan for a given story graph.
    SimpleStoryGraphTool
    A parent class for story graph tools that reads a story graph from file, performs an operation on that graph, and then write the graph back out to file.
    StoryGraphTool
    A parent class for story graph tools that provides some basic utilities for parsing command line arguments and printing help text.
    ToolArguments
    An object for parsing an array of string configuration arguments to a story graph tool, such as the command line arguments passed to a Java main method.
